provenance: Tobey C. Moss Gallery, Los Angeles | Acquired directly from above by the present owner | | Lot Essay | This striking engraving by Albrecht Dürer, created around 1500 in Nuremberg, depicts a witch riding backwards on a leaping goat amidst a hailstorm. Surrounded by mischievous putti carrying alchemical and magical symbols, the scene combines humor and menace, showcasing Dürer's masterful detail and exploration of supernatural themes.
